_about: Everything Bix can say out loud. Audio is generated from this file by tools/make_bix_voice.py. Lines never contain a child's name (the speech bubble can add it). Keep lines short and kind.
intro_hi: Hi there! I'm Bix! I'm a little bead from an abacus, and I love numbers!
intro_name: What's your name? Type it in for me!
intro_meet: Yay! Nice to meet you! Now, where should we start?
intro_pick: Grown-up, please pick the skill they're working on.
intro_check: Use your abacus for each one. No rush!
intro_done: Yay! Let's go! This is going to be so much fun!
ask_name: I don't know your name yet! Tap me and tell me!
hello_morning: Good morning! Ready to move some beads?
hello_afternoon: Good afternoon! Let's do some abacus!
hello_evening: Good evening! A little practice before bed?
hello_ready: Hi friend! Tap Start when you're ready!
hello_big: Big friends make ten. Let's practise!
hello_small: Small friends make five. Let's practise!
all_done: You did all of today's practice! Want to play a game?
locked: That one is locked! Finish the skills before it first.
tap_2: Boing! Boing! I'm a bouncy bead!
tap_3: Why was six afraid of seven? Because seven ate nine!
tap_4: What did the zero say to the eight? Nice belt!
tap_5: Four and six are big friends. Together they make ten!
tap_6: Two and three are small friends. They make five!
tap_7: The top bead is worth five. Each bottom bead is worth one!
tap_8: Thumb pushes beads up. Pointer finger pushes them down!
tap_9: In Japan, the abacus is called a soroban!
tap_10: The abacus is thousands of years old. Older than dinosaurs! Just kidding.
tap_11: What's a bead's favorite dance? The slide!
tap_12: Close your eyes and picture the beads. That's mental math!
tap_13: Seven needs three to make ten!
tap_14: Nine needs one to make ten!
tap_15: Why did the math book look sad? It had too many problems!
sum_great: Great job! Want to polish these with me?
sum_good: Good practice! Every try makes you stronger.
sum_fixed: You fixed every one! You're a star!
sum_unlock: Hooray! You unlocked a new skill!
gift: Ooh, a present for you! Tap it to open it!
gift_gold: Whoa, a gold sticker! Tap it!
today_done: Today's practice is all done! Hooray!
play_pick: Pick a game! Every game gives a sticker.
pop_go: Find the friend and pop it!
shop_pick: Pick a treat to save for!
shop_saving: Keep practising to fill the jar. You can do it!
shop_ready: You have enough now! Go get it!
shop_choice: Great choice! Let's save for it!
shop_yum: Yum! Show your ticket to a grown-up!
lesson_done: You learned a new skill! I'm so proud of you!
unlock_next: A new skill is open on the bead path!
